* Returns the host part of this ViaHeader.
    *
    * @return  the string value of the host

methods.comment: * Set the port part of this ViaHeader to the newly supplied port * parameter. * * @param port - the Integer.valueOf value of the port of this ViaHeader

methods.comment:
* Returns the port part of this ViaHeader.
     *

    *
    *@return the rport parameter or -1.

methods.name: public String getTransport()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value of the transport parameter.
     *
     * @return the string value of the transport paramter of the ViaHeader

methods.name: public void setTransport(String transport) throws ParseException
methods.comment:
* Sets the value of the transport. This parameter specifies
     * which transport protocol to use for sending requests and responses to
     * this entity. The following values are defined: "udp", "tcp", "sctp",
     * "tls", but other values may be used also.
     *
     * @param transport - new value for the transport parameter
     * @throws ParseException which signals that an error has been reached
     * unexpectedly while parsing the transport value.

methods.name: public String getProtocol()
methods.comment:
* Returns the value of the protocol used.
     *
     * @return the string value of the protocol paramter of the ViaHeader

methods.name: public void setProtocol(String protocol) throws ParseException
methods.comment:
* Sets the value of the protocol parameter. This parameter specifies
     * which protocol is used, for example "SIP/2.0".
     *
     * @param protocol - new value for the protocol parameter
     * @throws ParseException which signals that an error has been reached
     * unexpectedly while parsing the protocol value.

methods.name: public int getTTL()
methods.comment: * Returns the value of the ttl parameter, or -1 if this is not set. * * @return the integer value of the ttl parameter

methods.name: public void setTTL(int ttl) throws InvalidArgumentException
methods.comment:
* Sets the value of the ttl parameter. The ttl parameter specifies the
     * time-to-live value when packets are sent using UDP multicast.
     *
     * @param ttl - new value of the ttl parameter
     * @throws InvalidArgumentException if supplied value is less than zero or
     * greater than 255, excluding -1 the default not set value.

methods.name: public String getMAddr()
methods.comment: * Returns the value of the maddr parameter, or null if this * is not set. * * @return the string value of the maddr parameter

methods.name: public void setMAddr(String mAddr) throws ParseException
methods.comment: * Sets the value of the maddr parameter of this ViaHeader. The * maddr parameter indicates the server address to be contacted for this * user, overriding any address derived from the host field. * * @param mAddr new value of the maddr parameter * @throws ParseException which signals that an error has been reached * unexpectedly while parsing the mAddr value.

methods.name: public String getReceived()
methods.comment:
* Gets the received paramater of the ViaHeader. Returns null if received
     * does not exist.
     *
     * @return the string received value of ViaHeader

methods.name: public void setReceived(String received) throws ParseException
methods.comment:
* Sets the received parameter of ViaHeader.
     *
     * @param received - the newly supplied received parameter.
     * @throws ParseException which signals that an error has been reached
     * unexpectedly while parsing the received value.

methods.name: public String getBranch()
methods.comment:
* Gets the branch paramater of the ViaHeader. Returns null if branch
     * does not exist.

methods.name: public void setBranch(String branch) throws ParseException
methods.comment:

     * @throws ParseException which signals that an error has been reached
     * unexpectedly while parsing the branch value.
